item.title: Before You Upload a PDF: A Privacy Checklist

item.title: Image Compression: Pick the Right Format and Quality
item.description: Smaller images can speed up websites and make sharing easier. The best format depends on what is in the image, where it will be used, and how much quality you need to preserve.
